name: Novice
concept_ja: 潮水のしずくを浅い祈り鉢で受ける若い修道者。偉大な力より、日々の小さな務めと慎重な手つきを描く。
subject_en: A young adult woman with a short dark bob and a mended sage linen tunic, holding a shallow ivory ceramic prayer bowl steadily at her chest in both hands. Quiet concentration, relaxed rounded shoulders, one small droplet falling into the bowl; no spell gesture. Waist-up romantic illustrated fantasy portrait, fine ink contours and restrained painterly shading, face and bowl inside the central seventy percent.
silhouette_ja: 丸い短髪、低い肩、胸前の横長の鉢で、小さく閉じた楕円形をつくる。
motif_ja: 縁に欠けのある浅い象牙色の祈り鉢。48の継承要素となる。
background_en: A narrow black-green stone wash alcove in the Drowned Archive, a single seafoam reflection on wet masonry, distant storm daylight; simple and subdued. No text, card frame, emblems or statistics.
continuity_ja: Monk共通のセージ色の粗布、丸い道具、風化した石を使う。華美な後光や金属鎧を持たせずCommonの生活感を保つ。

name: Initiate
concept_ja: 風に揺れる二重の石珠を結び直し、自分の務めを引き受けた修道者。Noviceの内向きな姿に対し、正面に立つ落ち着きを持たせる。
subject_en: An adult man in his late twenties with close-cropped hair and a broad, calm face, wearing a simple ivory shoulder wrap over a seafoam tunic. He joins the cords of two large rounded gray-green prayer-stone loops at the center of his chest. Upright frontal waist-up pose, sleeves gathered at the wrists, no armor. Romantic fantasy illustration with detailed ink outlines and restrained shading; the face and paired loops remain within the central seventy percent.
silhouette_ja: 短く刈った頭と水平な肩布。胸元の大小二重の輪がNoviceの横長の鉢と区別される。
motif_ja: 中央で結ばれた大小二重の祈り石の輪。48のもう一方の継承要素。
background_en: A sheltered coastal cloister, rounded stone doorway and soft sea mist beyond, black-green walls with a little salt bloom and aged brass fixings. No writing, frame or game symbols.
continuity_ja: 素材はNoviceと共有し、衣服の面積や装飾量は増やしすぎない。行動属性のBarrierを盾アイコンとして固定しない。

name: Acolyte
concept_ja: 湿った廊下で小さな祈り灯を整える奉仕者。外套の大きなフードの中に、明るい顔と手元をまとめる。
subject_en: A slim adult with warm brown skin, freckles and a few curly locks escaping a large round sage hood. They shield a tiny ivory oil lamp in a palm-sized weathered stone cup while trimming its wick with the other hand. Three-quarter chest-up view, the hood forming a soft oval around the face, gentle practical attention. Romantic inked fantasy illustration with restrained painterly shadows; face, both hands and lamp grouped centrally.
silhouette_ja: 大きな円形フード、斜めに傾けた頭、小さな両手のくぼみ。
motif_ja: 丸く削られた石の灯皿と短い芯切り。小さな生活の灯りであり攻撃魔法ではない。
background_en: A quiet votive niche beside an archive corridor, wet sea-green stone and barely visible shelves of unmarked folded cloth; the small warm lamp contrasts with cold coastal air. No text, card border or action icon.
continuity_ja: 炎を陣営の主役にせず、Monkの海泡色・象牙色・石の丸みを優先する。Scholarの書物やEngineerの機構と重ねない。

name: Disciple
concept_ja: 潮に削られた回廊で、身体と重心を整える修行者。強さを大きな武器ではなく、踏ん張る体幹と開いた手で示す。
subject_en: A muscular adult woman around forty, dark hair tied in a low compact knot, wearing a sleeveless sage training wrap with plain ivory forearm bindings. She turns her torso into a grounded exercise stance, one open palm at chest height and the other hand low beside a rounded stone practice weight. Waist-up portrait with a broad triangular torso and steady eyes. Detailed ink contours, romantic fantasy character design and restrained painterly shading; the hands stay inside the central crop.
silhouette_ja: 厚い肩から腰へ絞る台形、片側だけ前へ出した開いた掌。鎧や長い武器を使わず力強さを出す。
motif_ja: 摩耗した前腕の布巻きと丸い石の重り。
background_en: An open-sided training cloister above a dark rough sea, a low rounded stone rail and rain-blurred archive buttresses. Muted sage and black-green, no magical shield, lettering or card frame.
continuity_ja: Knightの防具とは異なる粗布と身体の重心を見せる。Commonの道具は扱える大きさに限定する。

name: Mantra Burner
concept_ja: 仲間を守るために蓄えた祈願紙を使い切る係。失われるのは紙と蓄えで、人の身体を燃やす描写にはしない。
subject_en: A middle-aged monk with a narrow face, graying cropped hair and a patched ivory apron over sage robes. They lower the final unmarked votive-paper strip into a shallow stone censer, with already spent paper curling into pale ash above the bowl. A short, contained amber ember; the person is unharmed. Chest-up view, face and censer as two large readable masses. Romantic inked fantasy illustration with restrained shading and all important details in the central seventy percent.
silhouette_ja: 細い顔、垂れる袖、胸元に水平に据えた大きな石鉢。空になった紙束の紐を手首に残す。
motif_ja: 燃え尽きる無文字の祈願紙と空の束紐。資源を使い切って仲間へ託す固有能力の方向を示す。
background_en: A sheltered votive alcove in the drowned coastal archive, cool rounded stones and a thin veil of salt mist; a faint curved wake of ash suggests shelter without a literal ability icon. No text or card frame, no burning person.
continuity_ja: Burn能力の視覚的な代償を紙の消費に置く。戦闘で選ぶFLAMEなどの行動とは結び付けない。暖色の占有は小さく保つ。

name: Devotee
concept_ja: 嵐の夜も沈黙の務めを続ける巡礼者。重ねた実用布と一つの大きな祈り石で、生活者から専門家への深まりを表す。
subject_en: A tall older woman with silver hair braided close to her scalp, a deeply weathered face and layered seafoam traveling robes. She supports a single large oval prayer stone in a cloth sling at her chest, one broad palm resting against its salt-polished surface. Calm three-quarter waist-up pose with a heavy rounded mantle. Romantic illustrated fantasy, precise expressive ink lines and restrained painterly shadows; stone and face dominate the central crop.
silhouette_ja: 背の高い頭部、厚い丸襟、胸を覆う一枚の楕円石。低く横に広いNoviceとは縦の比率を変える。
motif_ja: 何度も補修された石の運搬布と、表面だけが手で磨かれた祈り石。
background_en: The entrance to a sea-carved pilgrimage passage beneath the Archive, rounded stone recesses and distant ivory rain light, subdued green-black depth. No readable inscriptions, text or frame.
continuity_ja: 装飾を増やす代わりに道具の重さ、布の重なり、修繕の時間でUncommonを表現する。

name: Contemplator
concept_ja: 水面に触れずに揺れを見つめる瞑想者。閉じた目だけに頼らず、波紋を観察する静かな鋭さを持たせる。
subject_en: An androgynous adult around thirty-five with long dark hair tied in a single low loop, wearing a high folded sage collar and plain ivory sleeves. Seated upright, they hold a polished round black-green water mirror at chest height and watch one diminishing ripple with open attentive eyes. Compact symmetrical chest-up composition, hands resting on opposite edges of the disc. Romantic fantasy ink illustration with soft painterly seafoam reflections, focal details centered.
silhouette_ja: 高い折り襟、細い首、胸前の真円。Devoteeの縦長で重い石とは薄い円盤で区別する。
motif_ja: 浅い水を張った黒緑色の石鏡と、消えかけの一つの波紋。
background_en: A still meditation chamber below the tide line, a rounded window reflecting distant storm water and a few soft ivory highlights on wet stone. Quiet negative space, no writing, ability symbols or frame.
continuity_ja: Scholarの占術具と区別し、星図や文字を描かず身体・水・石の観察に集中する。超常的な色の発光は抑える。

name: Monk Ascender
concept_ja: Noviceの祈り鉢とInitiateの二重の石珠を受け継いだ、二つの務めを担う修道者。進化を浮遊や過剰な光でなく、姿勢の完成として示す。
subject_en: A composed adult monk in their thirties with a smooth shaved head and an ivory cloth mantle over sage robes. They hold the shallow chipped ivory bowl of the Novice at sternum level, nested inside the two connected gray-green prayer-stone loops of the Initiate. Firm balanced shoulders, calm direct gaze, both hands supporting one unified ritual object. Symmetrical waist-up romantic fantasy portrait with detailed ink lines and restrained shading; all inherited objects fit within the central seventy percent.
silhouette_ja: なだらかな丸い肩布と、中心に集まる鉢と二重輪。地面に根を下ろす垂直軸をつくる。
motif_ja: 41の欠けた浅鉢と42の結び合わされた二重の石珠を、欠け・結び目ごと残す。
background_en: A simple elevated stone landing within the coastal cloister, two rounded arches merging into one dark passage, soft ivory sky reflected on damp black-green stone. No halo, levitation, writing or card frame.
continuity_ja: 実際の合成レシピ41＋42の形を明確に継承する。別人物への継承表現であり、LegendaryのAsceticと同一人物にはしない。

name: Elder
concept_ja: 長い年月の損失を引き受けてきた長老。割れた祈り鐘を静かに抱え、場全体の音が吸い込まれるような存在感をつくる。
subject_en: An elderly dark-skinned woman with a cloud of short white curls, fine deep wrinkles and a broad ivory mantle with a sage lining. She cradles a large cracked rounded stone prayer bell against her torso, her open hand quieting its rim. Strong frontal bust with a tender but unyielding gaze; tiny suspended droplets form a restrained hush around the broken bell. Romantic inked fantasy illustration, dignified age and painterly coastal light, face and bell large in the central crop.
silhouette_ja: 白い巻き毛の丸い頭、横に広い厚い肩布、逆釣鐘の道具。少ない大形で遠目の格を出す。
motif_ja: 修復せず抱え続ける割れた祈り鐘。失われた後にも相手へ影響が残る固有能力を、静けさの余韻へ翻訳する。
background_en: A broad ancient prayer hall with half-submerged rounded pillars receding into green-black darkness, a single ivory opening high behind the Elder. Environmental scale conveys influence; no crowd, readable markings or frame.
continuity_ja: 死や破壊を人体の損傷で描かず、割れた道具と余韻で示す。豪華な王冠ではなく年齢と場の大きさでRareをつくる。

name: Ascetic
concept_ja: 既存の長い白髪と静かな眼差しを持つAsceticを、嵐の中心でも揺れない修道院の象徴として再解釈する。人物の同一性は残し、舞台と素材を現在の世界観に合わせる。
subject_en: Preserve the established Ascetic identity: an elegant pale adult with very long flowing ivory hair, heavy sweeping fringe, a solemn narrow-eyed gaze, sculpted raised shoulder pieces and a slender vertical ceremonial staff. Keep the delicate face and composed three-quarter seated bearing. Translate the ornate shoulders into aged brass over a black-green mantle with sage lining; retain a very small muted violet gem as a personal heirloom. One gloved hand rests across the staff near the chest. Romantic anime-fantasy illustration with rich ink contours and restrained painterly shading; face, flowing hair and staff remain central.
silhouette_ja: 既存の長い白髪、持ち上がった肩の輪郭、一本の垂直な杖を維持する。髪が外へ流れても顔と杖は中央に残す。
motif_ja: 細い儀礼杖、象牙色の長髪、小さく残した紫の宝石。背後には摩耗した丸い祈り石の構造を置く。
background_en: The deepest rounded sanctuary of the Drowned Archive, a massive weathered stone ring and storm waves held visually still through a distant aperture. Green-black stone, ivory rim light, seafoam mist and limited aged brass. No text, decorative card border or literal action symbols.
continuity_ja: 元絵の顔立ち・髪・杖・肩の輪郭を人物識別の軸にする。陣営色変更で完全な別人にせず、旧来の紫は個人的な遺品として小面積だけ残す。

name: Tinkerer
concept_ja: 漂着した部品を掌の工具で測り、小さな潮力機構を組み直す若い修繕屋。大発明より、手元を覗き込む好奇心を主役にする。
subject_en: A young adult with unruly cropped auburn hair, a graphite canvas vest and rolled ivory sleeves. They lift a small patinated copper ratchet housing close to their face and measure it with a distinctive fork-shaped brass caliper. Intent curious expression, one eyebrow raised; three-quarter chest-up composition with elbows tucked in. Romantic illustrated fantasy with detailed ink contours and restrained painterly amber reflections, face and both small tools grouped in the central seventy percent.
silhouette_ja: 短く跳ねた髪、前に傾いた頭、小さく閉じた肘。胸前の二股のノギスで識別する。
motif_ja: 二股の真鍮ノギスと、角の欠けた小さな銅のラチェット外殻。58へ継承する。
background_en: A cramped repair bench inside the coastal Archive, a few large salvaged parts and wet black-green masonry, soft amber task light and cold sea mist beyond a narrow slit. No text, numbers, frame or futuristic screens.
continuity_ja: Engineer共通の銅の緑青、黒鉛色の作業布、角ばった機構を導入する。現代電動工具や大量の細かい歯車は避ける。

name: Mechanic
concept_ja: 潮の逆流に備えて手動の留め具を締める整備工。Tinkererより頑丈な体格と工具の長い対角線で区別する。
subject_en: A stocky adult woman in her forties with close-shaved sides and a short dark topknot, wearing a graphite leather apron and a copper elbow brace. She braces a broad square ratchet key diagonally across her chest, tightening the dog-toothed coupling of a tidal valve. Confident tired smile and salt-stained gloves. Waist-up romantic fantasy illustration with expressive ink outlines and restrained shading; the handle stays inside the central crop.
silhouette_ja: 四角い頭部、厚い前腕、斜めに渡る角形の工具。小さなTinkererより幅と重心を下げる。
motif_ja: 四角い輪郭のラチェットキーと歯止め式の弁継手。58の大きな機構へ継承する。
background_en: A low tidal pumping chamber, one thick copper pipe and a black-green stone bulkhead wet with sea spray. Muted amber light, simple industrial shapes, no readable labels, frame or modern technology.
continuity_ja: 力は身体と手動機構で表し、Commonに大きな外骨格を持たせない。銅の摩耗した縁と緑青を共通素材にする。

name: Forger
concept_ja: 一枚の鋼材に確かな形を与える鍛造職人。Forge Workerの炉へ捧げる行為と区別し、叩く直前の職人の判断を描く。
subject_en: A broad-shouldered middle-aged man with a short braided dark beard, heavy graphite work apron and bare forearms marked only by soot. He holds a compact square-faced hammer upright beside his chest while checking an ivory-hot metal brace in broad copper tongs. Serious eyes, body turned slightly sideways, a clipped triangular shoulder silhouette. Romantic inked fantasy artwork with restrained amber heat and painterly shadows; no flying sparks obscuring face or hands.
silhouette_ja: 短い編み髭、片側に立つ角槌、横へ張る肘。腕の形でMechanicの斜め工具と区別する。
motif_ja: 四角い槌頭と、製作途中の一枚の折れ曲がった金属支持具。
background_en: A small practical forge built into black-green archive stone, one low anvil and a narrow seawater quenching trough. Contained amber glow with copper patina and cool salt shadows; no frame, inscriptions or modern furnace controls.
continuity_ja: 実用品を作る姿に留め、炉の巨大さでは格付けしない。熱源は工房の環境でありカードの行動属性を固定しない。

name: Inventor
concept_ja: 小型の潮流測定器を初めて回す発明家。完成された権威ではなく、試行錯誤の継ぎはぎと期待の表情を見せる。
subject_en: A lanky adult woman with tightly curled brown hair held by two plain copper pins, an oversized graphite coat and unevenly rolled sleeves. She balances a palm-sized three-vane tidal rotor inside a square copper testing jig, watching it with a delighted but analytical half-smile. One shoulder higher than the other, long fingers supporting the jig near her collarbone. Romantic illustrated fantasy, clear ink outlines and restrained painterly shading; central face and single readable device.
silhouette_ja: 縦に細い体、左右で違う肩の高さ、胸上の四角い治具。三枚羽根をひとつの記憶点にする。
motif_ja: 継ぎ足した銅の角枠に収まる三枚羽根の小型潮流ローター。
background_en: An improvised workshop at an archive sea window, coarse dark workbench and one blurred tide channel outside. Sage-green corrosion, graphite fabric and limited amber task light; no blue holograms, text or card frame.
continuity_ja: Architectの丸眼鏡・豊かな灰髪・完成された金属肩を使わない。小さな試作品と未完成の衣服でCommonに留める。

name: Forge Worker
concept_ja: 仲間の装備へ最後の出力を送るため、保存していた炉心材を投入する作業者。Burnの代償は消費される炉心材に置く。
subject_en: An adult engineer with a shaved head, sturdy build and soot-dark graphite protective cape, face visible behind a raised plain copper visor. With insulated tongs they feed the final angular amber forge charge into a small crucible mouth at chest level; an empty charge rack hangs at their side. The charge begins to crumble into bright granular slag, while the worker remains unharmed. Waist-up romantic inked fantasy, restrained painterly firelight, clear central face and deliberate hands.
silhouette_ja: 丸い坊主頭に跳ね上げた角形バイザー、裾の短い四角い防熱ケープ。手前の炉心材を大きくする。
motif_ja: 最後の琥珀色の炉心材と空の保管枠。仲間のために蓄えを使い切る不可逆性を示す。
background_en: A tide-powered forge station, copper channels carrying a small warm glow toward indistinct neighboring workstations, green-black masonry and salt-worn metal. No burning body, explosive spectacle, text or card frame.
continuity_ja: 55のBurnによるEngineer支援を、炉心材の消費と周囲へ渡る熱で表現する。53は造形作業、55は蓄えの投入として区別する。

name: Schematic
concept_ja: 人物ではなく、潮力設備の仕組みを立体で記録する携行式の設計具。細かな紙の図面より、折り畳み機構そのものを収集したくなる対象にする。
subject_en: An antique portable mechanical schematic, no person: a graphite-black hinged case opened into a compact upright triptych, containing a raised patinated-copper cutaway model of a tidal engine. One large ratchet, a slanted water channel and an ivory float are mechanically linked; two folded caliper arms bracket the model. It stands on a low stone plinth at chest-height viewpoint, all essential parts grouped in the central seventy percent. Romantic fantasy artifact illustration, precise hand-inked contours and restrained painterly metallic shading.
silhouette_ja: 中央が高い三面の折り畳み箱と左右の角形アーム。人物の頭や肩と一目で違う輪郭にする。
motif_ja: 紙に文字を描かず、潮汐エンジンの立体断面を保存した機械模型。象牙色の浮きが視線の中心。
background_en: A quiet engineering archive shelf bay, green-black stone and a single high sea window reflected faintly in copper edges. Dark uncluttered space around the artifact, no letters, numbers, blueprint labels, card frame or holograms.
continuity_ja: 既存カード名Schematicを変更せず器物として多様性をつくる。Engineerの計測・潮力・銅の素材を人物カードと共有する。

name: Constructor
concept_ja: 浸水した書庫の梁を組み直す建設技師。職人から一段広い仕事を、身体に沿う実用的な作業外骨格で表す。
subject_en: An older muscular woman with a silver undercut, square jaw and a graphite padded work coat. A compact angular patinated-copper lifting exoskeleton follows her shoulders and forearms; she guides a single diagonal ivory-stone brace into alignment with a broad mechanical clamp. Waist-up three-quarter portrait, focused expression, visible human hands operating simple levers. Romantic fantasy ink drawing with restrained painterly copper and amber shading; the head and clamp remain central.
silhouette_ja: 肩から立つ二本の角形支持枠と、片側へ斜めに渡る石材。人間の胴の外側へ一段だけ輪郭を拡張する。
motif_ja: 身体の動きに沿う銅の昇降枠と大きな一個の締具。
background_en: An archive gallery under repair above shallow seawater, simple stone ribs, one suspended brace and distant storm light. No busy scaffolding maze, readable plans, sci-fi armor or card border.
continuity_ja: 重機に乗る操縦者ではなく、人が手で制御する補助機構を描く。59の非人間的な巨大機体と規模を明確に分ける。

name: Engineer Forgemaster
concept_ja: Tinkererの精度とMechanicの確かな整備を一体化した技師。合成元の工具を、大きなひとつの校正機構へ組み込む。
subject_en: A seasoned adult engineer with copper-red hair swept into a neat short crest, a dark graphite high-collared work jacket and a single patinated copper shoulder brace. They hold an integrated calibration rig at chest height: the Tinkerer's distinctive fork-shaped brass caliper locks into the Mechanic's broad square ratchet key and dog-toothed coupling. A confident concentrated gaze, precise two-handed grip, balanced angular silhouette. Romantic fantasy illustration with detailed ink contours and restrained painterly shading, inherited tool forms large and central.
silhouette_ja: 整った短い髪、片側の角形肩枠、胸元に横長の校正治具。57ほど外側へ広がらず精密さを見せる。
motif_ja: 51の二股ノギスと52の四角いラチェットキーを合体し、欠けや歯止めの形を残す。
background_en: A calibrated tidal-forge bench inside the Archive, one copper turbine housing seated in black-green stone, ivory inspection light and restrained amber metal reflections. No text, glowing action icons or card frame.
continuity_ja: 実際の合成レシピ51＋52の器具を識別できる大きさで継承する。Forgeという名前でも55の資源投入や53の槌作業を繰り返さない。

name: Colossus
concept_ja: 潮力設備そのものが起き上がった巨大な建造機。少数の大きな機構と接続口によって、仲間の機械を支える陣営全体の存在感を示す。
subject_en: A monumental nonhuman tidal construct shown from waist to head at a slightly low angle. Broad rectangular patinated-copper shoulder housings, a compact recessed ivory inspection lens for a head, graphite stone-and-metal torso and one enormous diagonal ratchet arm. Three thick mechanical power couplings meet at a single restrained amber chest flywheel; there is no human pilot. Hand-inked romantic fantasy artifact design with restrained painterly weathering, large legible mechanical masses and a central focal lens and flywheel.
silhouette_ja: 極端に幅広い四角い肩、小さく奥まった頭、斜めの巨大腕。Constructorの人間らしい肩と顔を残さない。
motif_ja: 三つの機械的接続口が集まる胸のはずみ車。仲間のEngineerが揃うほど力を増す固有能力に呼応する。
background_en: A drowned machine hall of the coastal Archive, distant stone arches and a small ordinary maintenance ladder establishing scale, storm water below. Dark green-black environment, aged copper and limited amber energy, no numbers, runic text, lasers or frame.
continuity_ja: 機体を大量の細かい歯車や現代ロボット顔にしない。59は陣営の巨大な道具、60はそれを設計する人物として主役を分ける。

name: Architect
concept_ja: 既存の豊かな灰髪、丸眼鏡、余裕のある微笑みを持つArchitect。海に抗う書庫の構造を掌で読む、技師陣営の象徴にする。
subject_en: Preserve the established Architect identity: an elegant adult with abundant long wavy gray hair, a sweeping fringe, small round metal spectacles and a knowing half-smile. Keep the high collar and ornate rounded shoulder plates, translated into salt-worn aged brass and patinated copper over graphite fabric, with a small muted violet inner collar recalling the original. They hold one open angular survey caliper across the chest as if assessing the Archive itself. Romantic anime-fantasy character illustration with rich expressive ink contours and restrained painterly shading; glasses, face, hair and tool stay central.
silhouette_ja: 豊かな波打つ長髪、小さな丸眼鏡、丸く張った金属肩の既存輪郭を維持する。手元の角形測定具がEngineerの線を補う。
motif_ja: 丸眼鏡と測量用の大きな開きノギス。背後の潮力構造と同じ曲率が肩の装飾に反復する。
background_en: The crown of a vast tidal engine beneath the Drowned Archive, one monumental copper arc and black-green coastal buttresses visible through storm mist. Ivory rim light, restrained amber reflections and a little seafoam corrosion; no writing, decorative card frame, floating interface or action icon.
continuity_ja: 元絵の灰髪・眼鏡・微笑み・肩の形を保存する。新しい陣営色は素材と照明から導入し、紫の襟を個人的な継承要素として少量残す。
